findings.issue: Degenerate edge: the validator only requires `durationSec > 0`, but a selfStatus with durationSec < 1/120 s rounds to 0 frames (expiry === open frame). For a frame-0 producer (passive/battleStart, applied in setup BEFORE the loop) the dispatch at frame 0 sees `expiry === 0` and fires the end block for a window that was never open; for a mid-fight producer the same 0-frame status can never fire (the frame's dispatch already ran). Unreachable with any realistic kit value; recording it so nobody 'fixes' one half later.
findings.suggestedFix: Optional: tighten the selfStatus validator to `Math.round(durationSec * 60) >= 1` (validate-structural.ts:801) so a status always spans at least one frame; otherwise leave as is.

findings.issue: Same-frame ordering is a convention worth one more comment line: producers that run BEFORE this dispatch at the lapse frame (PREFB FB-start `fullBurstEnter` blocks at 3610, delayed `pendingBlocks` landing at 3631) EXTEND the window and suppress the fire; producers that run AFTER it (interval blocks, burstCast, shot triggers) fire the end block first and then re-open. Both readings are defensible ('removed then re-applied' vs 'refreshed'), but the asymmetry is implicit.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a sentence to the dispatch comment naming which producers precede it in the frame, so a future carrier whose re-application lands via delaySec/fullBurstEnter is not surprised by the missing end-fire.
